file_roles.evidence: In copy_data_between_tables, abort_on_warning is cleared around the push_warning('ORDER BY ignored ...') and restored after; with it set the warning became an error and my_ok then hit the Diagnostics_area assertion.

rationale: A warning was escalated to an error under abort_on_warning, setting the diagnostics area before mysql_alter_table later called my_ok. The fix prevents that escalation at the push_warning site.
